hero.html:
Level 3 - Intermediate 30 min OOP Walmart

Composition over Inheritance

After this page you can explain is-a versus has-a, show with running code how a subclass breaks when its base class changes (the fragile base class), turn an exploding class hierarchy into a few composed parts, walk through the "replace inheritance with delegation" refactor, and give a balanced answer to "why use inheritance at all if composition can do it?"
